versions.changelog:
whale-sentiment v1.0.0

- Initial release of the whale-sentiment signal.
- Provides real-time sentiment from Hyperliquid top traders, integrated with APEX Runner’s live trading system.
- Accessible via x402-authenticated API calls; requires only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet.
- No API key or account required—automatic payment authorisation handled by x402 client.
- Tiered, usage-based pricing with early adopter discounts.
